title: Physics-residual machine learning predicts oxygen-evolution catalyst activity beyond the training range from sparse polarization measurements
abstract: arXiv:2609.23549v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Screening oxygen-evolution catalysts on combinatorial libraries requires deciding which candidates receive the remaining measurements. The deciding activity lies beyond each candidate's measured potential window and often above every activity recorded during fitting. We predict it by physics-residual machine learning: the Tafel equation extrapolates the candidate's own measured current and slope, a learned residual attenuated with feature-space distance corrects the magnitude, and an applicability-domain score identifies predictions above the training range before measurement. In a separately fabricated 322-candidate library, 282 above the training maximum, two measurements per candidate gave a mean absolute error of 0.203 mA cm$^{-2}$ against 1.330 for the selected data-driven machine-learning model. translated_title: 物理残差机器学习从稀疏极化测量中预测超出训练范围的析氧催化剂活性
translated_abstract: 在组合库上筛选析氧催化剂时，需要决定哪些候选材料将接受剩余的测量。而决定性的活性位于每个候选材料已测电位窗口之外，且往往高于拟合期间记录的所有活性。我们通过物理残差机器学习来预测这一活性：Tafel方程对候选材料自身测量的电流和斜率进行外推，一个随特征空间距离衰减的学习残差对幅值进行修正，适用域评分则在测量之前识别出超出训练范围的预测。在一个单独制备的包含322个候选材料的库中（其中282个高于训练最大值），每个候选材料仅需两次测量即可达到0.203 mA cm⁻²的平均绝对误差，而所选的数据驱动机器学习模型误差为1.330。训练范围内的误差仍保持相当水平，且仅需35个标记催化剂即可完成拟合。在两个独立数据集中，同样的……（原文在此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出物理残差机器学习方法，将Tafel方程外推与随特征空间距离衰减的学习残差修正相结合，仅凭稀疏极化测量（每个候选材料两次测量、35个标记催化剂）即可准确预测超出训练范围的析氧催化剂活性，误差比纯数据驱动模型低约6.5倍。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a physics-residual machine learning approach that combines Tafel-equation extrapolation with a distance-attenuated learned residual correction, enabling accurate prediction of oxygen-evolution catalyst activity beyond the training range from sparse polarization measurements (two per candidate, only 35 labeled catalysts), achieving roughly 6.5× lower error than purely data-driven models.
